snippet.title: SILLY LINGUINE CAT SIMULATOR DELUXE ONLINE - OFFICIAL TRAILER #1
snippet.description:
THE FIRST TRAILER FOR THE BIGGEST GAME OF THE YEAR - SILLY LINGUINE CAT SIMULATOR DELUXE ONLINE! Gameplay:
The general gameplay of SLCSDO (Silly Linguine Cat Simulator Deluxe Online) is that you have to pet Silly Linguine Cat, you will have pet goals, when you get to that amount of pets, you will get a random crate (gambling!!!!). These crates can be opened to reward you with skins for Linguine Cat! However, If gambling isn't your thing, then lucky for you we have one other core gameplay mechanic, the leaderboard!!! The leaderboard will show who has pet silly linguine the most! (We have implemented a top-of-the-line anti cheat system, so don't even think about it.) Ok so that's pretty much everything, crates, pet cat, leaderboard, yep that's everything. oh actually we also have music, that's kinda a gameplay feature. yea.

Skins
We have so many skins for silly linguine, at the time of writing dis we got like 250 but by time this game releases we will have 300-350 skins. ok here are the rarities:

Common - these are cool but not that cool

Uncommon - very neat

Rare - they look cool

Ultra-Rare - these are very cool

Legendary - these are the coolest they all have unique idle and click animations and took the longest to make

Who is Silly Linguine Cat
Hes my cat, his real name is raikou, hes about as smart as a stupid cat but hes orange so thats normal.
